facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: "Come outside, my dears." Ms. Clara held two watering cans. Emma took one, Ben took the other. The garden was thirsty. They walked between flower beds. They poured water gently. Bees buzzed a small thank you. The nanny showed small kindness.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Ms. Clara invited Emma and Ben into the morning garden after breakfast. The grass was still wet, and butterflies were waking up. "These flowers are thirsty," she said gently, handing each child a tiny green watering can. She showed them how to tip the can slowly so the water fell like soft rain. They walked carefully between the rows of daisies, marigolds, and forget-me-nots, sprinkling water on every dry leaf. A bumblebee buzzed past Ben's ear, and he giggled. The flowers seemed to bow with thanks, their colors shining brighter than before. The nanny showed small kindness, and the children learned to look closer at the world around them.
